test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Bolt from the blue

options.text: To win a large sum of money

solution:
The correct answer is **To receive unexpected news.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom is **To receive unexpected news.**
 
• The idiom** Bolt from the blue **means** **To receive unexpected news.
 
 
• ​Example: My parents announced they were moving to Australia next month, and that news hit me like a bolt from the blue.
 
 
 
• Thus the correct answer would be To receive unexpected news.
